name: Mendoza
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The public Guaymallén parcel layer passed bounded retrieval, paging, all 363 fresh native-ID geometry reads, explicit valid-format absence, full footprint lookup and actual proposal binding. Independent GEOS found eight overlaps above 0.01 m², including 268.254 m² and 133.021 m²; their source meaning remains unresolved. Runtime is held without geometry repair or selective deletion.
scopeLimits: Guaymallén municipal parcels in the Mendoza population settlement. The exact WUP locator returned empty in Capital, Godoy Cruz and Guaymallén layers; nearby Guaymallén polygons were verified. Nine aligned 0.001° cells plus four cardinal extension cells produced 363 distinct full parcels. Three nearby full polygons are retained; the bounded union stayed temporary. All 363 legal nomenclatu strings refreshed exactly, native EPSG:3857 count/object-ID manifests agreed, forced three-row batches completed 47 rows over 16 pages, and a selected polygon passed actual footprint binding. GEOS EPSG:32719 found all 363 valid and distinct, with 18 positive-area intersections, eight above 0.01 m². No citywide or countrywide completeness is asserted.
